question: Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
evidence: cards have missing or degraded properties and value refers to hasContentWarning = 1; 'Stephen Daniele' is artist; Find all cards refers to return card id
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
gold0: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

d.request: Find all card IDs illustrated by Stephen Daniele. Include each card’s ruling text and whether `hasContentWarning = 1`, and retain cards with no matching rulings record.
d.sql: SELECT c.id, r.text AS rulingText, (c.hasContentWarning = 1) AS hasContentWarning FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

b.request: Return the IDs of all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniele, their ruling text if available (including cards with no rulings record), and whether each card has `hasContentWarning = 1`
b.sql: SELECT c.id, r.text AS rulingText, c.hasContentWarning = 1 AS hasContentWarning FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

c.request:
Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
Evidence: cards have missing or degraded properties and value refers to hasContentWarning = 1; 'Stephen Daniele' is artist; Find all cards refers to return card id
Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
c.sql: SELECT c.id AS card_id, r.text AS ruling_text, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_missing_or_degraded_properties_and_values FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele' ORDER BY c.id, r.id;
